history.title: Our history
history.p1: Founded as a regional horticulture supplier, Oboya has grown into a global partner supporting propagation, growing, packaging, and retail display.
history.p2: Today we operate across 25 countries with local teams, production hubs, and strategic partners serving growers worldwide.

mission.title: Mission, vision & values
mission.description: We help growers deliver quality, efficiency, and sustainability across the supply chain.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To be the most trusted integrated horticulture partner worldwide.

values.title: Values
values.description: Integrity, innovation, and sustainability guide every decision we make.

m1.title: Company founded
m1.description: Oboya begins as a regional horticulture supplier.

m2.title: European expansion
m2.description: First distribution hubs open across Northern Europe.

m3.title: Packaging innovation
m3.description: Retail-ready packaging line launched for berries and vegetables.

m4.title: Asia-Pacific growth
m4.description: Production and sales offices established in key APAC markets.

m5.title: Sustainability program
m5.description: Circular packaging and waste-reduction initiatives scaled globally.

m6.title: Digital B2B shop
m6.description: International quotation platform launched for commercial buyers.

presence.title: Global presence
presence.description: With offices, warehouses, and partners across continents, we support growers close to their operations.
